Biplanar and Triplanar texture coordinate generation

Texture coordinate generation mode (tex_gen) enables generation of texture coordinates in the shader. The two modes currently supported are biplanar and triplanar. Biplanar is the less GPU intensive mode.

Enabling tex_gen can improve the quality of PBR shading on geometry with non-uniform texture-coordinates. Compare a jit.gl.gridshape @type capsule with and without tex_gen enabled.

Neither of these modes are compatible with parallax heightmaps.

Heightmaps are currently only supported by enabling parallax mapping. Conversely parallax mode requires a heightmap. Currenlty the biplanar and triplanar tex_gen modes are disabled, and both normal maps and ambient-occlusion maps will be ignored when parallax mapping is enabled.
